selection: First20 eligible (gameID,ply,source,target), sorted, from immutable geometric result.json. No replacement for failed/inconclusive certificates; no other cohort.
horizon: Our quiet fork, every legal enemy reply, one public choice of our surviving actor capturing an originally forked disclosed victim, every legal enemy next reply. Fixed20,000 generated enemy outcome nodes per candidate; cap means inconclusive.
public_worlds: Known ranks exact. Concealed enemy legal actions are the union over count-feasible mobile ranks; include unknown Scout long rays. One-step unknown quiet moves retain unknown identity, grouping indistinguishable ranks into one public successor, so our response cannot depend on undisclosed rank. Longer Scout moves disclose rank. Combat discloses rank and branches over count-feasible identities. Updated hidden inventory and moved-slot feasibility reject impossible branches. This is a conservative count/movement public supermodel, not actual hidden identities or source-template worlds.
objective: For each first enemy public outcome there must exist one legal surviving-actor capture of an original forked victim with a strictly positive worst-case fixed-root-native-worth net material balance after ALL second enemy replies, OR a terminal own win. Include ALL friendly losses, enemy equal exchanges, own Flag capture and both sides' no-moves terminal rules. Any own loss/draw in an outcome refutes that response. Enemy quiet moves are included, not replaced by pass.
choice: The response is chosen per public first-enemy observation, then held fixed across every compatible second reply. No response may depend on an undisclosed quiet mover's rank. The gate does not require agreement with the saved selected move. Certificate is bounded material conversion, not game win unless explicitly terminal.
scope: No runtime or score implementation; proof fixture and screening audit only. Native pursuit may already convert these positions, so positive certificates are not automatically missed wins or evidence of strength. Preserve refutations/inconclusive/cost and no gate widening.
